Author: Asunnya (fork of Anomek's AnoMech)
Name: AsuMech
Punchline: Another FFXIV mechanics simulator: a fork of AnoMech with Savage, more Ultimates and a Learn mode.
Description: Asunnya's fork of AnoMech: spawns fake party members and bosses client-side so you can practice raid mechanics without a full party. Everything from AnoMech, plus Savage (M9S to M11S), DSR, UCOB and UWU, and a Learn mode that guides you through each strat. Questions, strats and bug reports: https://discord.gg/y6kTkdaXjz
Changelog: 0.6.1.1: M12S, the whole fight from the opener to the finale (Toxic Friends and DN strats), with Learn lessons; FRU P1 Fatebreaker (Utopian Sky, Turn of the Heavens, Fall of Faith), P2 Mirror, Mirror and the Ice Veil intermission, with lessons, and the Oracle's jumps, Darklit, Crystallize Time, Ultimate Relativity and Paradise Regained follow real pulls; UCoB: Tuufless (Elemental) strats for every phase, the P3 Seventh Umbral Era opener, P2 Nael picks Push or No push from tabs, and Twintania and Nael follow real pulls (a missed tank swap kills, every player gets thunder and doom marks, Dalamud Dive goes to the off tank); UMAD: P1 Opening, P2 Trines and P3 Decisive Battle, and fixes to Forsaken towers, Limit Cut, Black Hole, Kefka Says and the fire stack; UWU: Landslide, Vulcan Burst and Searing Wind hit and knock back as in the fight; DSR P2 Meteors is a tab of Thordan, so Run to end plays it once; Splatoon layouts and scripts for the fight work inside a run (Settings); runs can start from your FC private chambers (Settings, off by default); the firewall refuses a run until its opcodes for the current patch are published and closing the game mid-run keeps the filter up; recordings name the plugin version they came from. 0.6.1.0: Run to end plays a whole fight as one run, in Practice and in Learn, with section tabs for TEA P3/P4 and TOP P6; Learn lessons for TOP: P1 Program Loop, P3 Intermission, Hello World and Monitors, P4 Blue Screen, Delta and Sigma (Tuufless) and the whole of P6; toolbox pictures follow the lesson step by step (DSR P1, and pages for DSR P5, FRU P5, M10S, UCOB P2 and P5, UMAD P2); a recorded pull now saves a richer CSV and its own combat log; FRU Ultimate Relativity bots stand where real parties do; Viper's Reaving Fangs and Reaving Maw start their combos; a slow inn reload no longer breaks the zone-in. 0.6.0.4: UCOB fixes from playtesting: each phase has its own arena, Nael says her quotes over her head, the Geminus dragons and the P2 dragons hit their targets, puddles and twisters go away, the Heavensfall trio shows and bots dodge where the dives really land, Tenstrike bots stay out of your Earth Shaker, the P2 stack rotates a quarter turn per puddle, and the Phoenix transition is its own scenario; guides for M9S, M10S, M12S and TEA; the UMAD P1 lesson shows the WTFDIG pictures. 0.6.0.3: the whole of UCOB after Twintania: Nael's ending as a clear plays it, with the divebombs as an option, every Bahamut Prime trio (Quickmarch, Blackfire, Fellruin, Heavensfall, Tenstrike, Grand Octet), the adds and Golden Bahamut; The Epic of Alexander (P1 to P4); TOP P1 Program Loop, P3 Intermission, Hello World and Monitors, P4 Blue Screen and the whole of P6; Tuufless for TOP Delta and Sigma; better Monk, Viper and Bard actions. 0.6.0.2: Guided and Assisted for UMAD P5 Celestriad and Exaflares, FRU Crystallize Time and UCOB P5 Exaflares; a Discord link in the window and the feedback popup. 0.6.0.1: a recording you sent is removed from your disk (Settings can keep a copy), and Settings can delete every saved recording. 0.6: AnoMech is now AsuMech. Uninstall AnoMech: AsuMech imports its settings (relay, streaks, recent fights) the first time it starts. New: a Learn mode that guides you through each strat step by step, with the strat's toolbox picture and a thumbs up/down on every step; Report a problem from inside a run (a solo run pauses while you write, and the run's details are sent with it); scenario and strat requests no longer need a GitHub account; your best streak shows beside your streak. Multiplayer now uses the AsuMech server by default.
